test_title: PYST 133: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 27 Jan, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice, with the symbols *, ?, @, %, $, ∞ , are shown. Find the symbol on the face opposite the face showing '*'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51586862243bef537545e3903b1a0940b8026a454543039b489f948000867ae3.png]
solution: As '?' and '@' are the common faces on both the dice, the remaining faces are opposite to each other. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51586862243bef537545e3903b1a0940b8026a454543039b489f948000867ae3.png] Therefore, the symbol on the face opposite the face showing '*' is '∞'.
